served_prose: How this console is served: its port, whether it is encrypted, and who can reach it.
served_network: Encrypted, and offered to the network.
served_local: Encrypted, and offered to this machine alone.
served_plain_network: Not encrypted, and offered to the network, so anyone on the path can read what it shows and what is typed into it.
served_plain_local: Not encrypted. It is offered to this machine alone.
served_named: A request from beyond this machine has to name {name}.
served_unrecorded: Where this console is served could not be written down: {reason}
served_compare: Compare this with what your browser shows for this page's certificate.
served_alarm_prose: This console is served to the network without encryption, so anyone on the path can read what it shows and what is typed into it. This stays here until it is served encrypted.
stack_prose: How to run the stack without lemonfiber, from this machine's own files.
settled_prose: What setup settled, read from the configuration as it stands.
settled_no_root: No place is set for the library.
settled_usenet: Downloading over Usenet is set up.
settled_no_usenet: Downloading over Usenet is not set up.
settled_no_torrent: Downloading torrents is not set up.
settled_user_set: Services run as user {uid} and group {gid}, both as you set them.
settled_user_part: Services run as user {uid} and group {gid}: you set one, and the other is that of the stack folder's owner, or 1000 where that owner is root or cannot be read.
settled_user_owner: Services run as user {uid} and group {gid}: you set neither, so both are those of the stack folder's owner, or 1000 where that owner is root or cannot be read.
settled_none: This stack is not set up.
decision_prose: Each answer setup wrote, and what changing it affects. Values are not shown here.
decision_config: Changed in the list above, under {key}.
unmanaged_prose: What you declared lemonfiber leaves alone, and why.
unmanaged_more: {count} more areas are declared and not listed here.
